_note: How bodies move physically (src/physics_kit/motion_kit.gd, MotionKit; BAUPLAN M1b, skill gamedev:physics-tuning). The knock speeds per blow kind stay with each world (hell_balance.json / krypta_balance.json monsters.feel.knock, frost_theme.json vfx.knock); everything else is here.

knock._note: The hero's knockback: start speed (px/s, from the world's table) away from the blow, squashed on the floor's depth by squash [x, y]; it eases out as (1 - t/time)^ease_power over the world's time s (time_min the shortest), so it covers about speed x time / 3 px; no frame moves him more than step_max px (world px, well under a 96 px cell), so he never tunnels; walls stop each axis. time and mob_scale (a mob's blow pushes this share) are used when the world's table has none.

grip._note: Grip = the share of the old speed left after one second (1 = firm floor, the wanted speed at once). slip = under the slip condition (src/hell/hero_fx.gd), medium = a sliding pool or gas without its own grip (element_rules.json gives ice 0.015 and blood 0.35), glaze = the world's glaze ice tiles without their own (theme liquid grip).

skid._note: Sliding over a pool's ice or blood faster than speed px/s, the hero's boots scratch it: a spray of chips every s seconds.

push._note: A monster's push velocity (px/s, set by blows, blasts and waves) is added to its movement and keeps decay of it per 60th of a second (MotionKit.step_body, so the same at any frame rate). Talent hits add their push (talent px/s, boss_talent for bosses) away from the blast that struck, divided by the body's mass (its radius over the median radius of the world's monsters, squared, within mass [min, max]; mass_ref_r while there are none: hell_game.gd body_mass); the summed push is at most max px/s (physics plan R23, decision D5).
